note: Grok Bot plugins/connectors referenced by this template. Not auto-configured in Pi; add equivalent MCP servers with `pi mcp add` or .pi/mcp.json.

plugins.name: Linear
plugins.description: Optional. Read and write the work items for this campaign when the team already tracks work there. A plain list in this chat works instead.

plugins.name: Notion
plugins.description: Optional. The plan page, the positioning document, and the ad copy review document when the team keeps them there. A file under /workspace/pm/ works instead.

plugins.name: Slack
plugins.description: Optional. Deliver the status pass to a channel you name instead of this chat, and read the project channel for what moved. Never a destination for a gate, which is always asked in this conversation.

plugins.name: Google Drive
plugins.description: Optional. Where briefs, positioning documents, ad copy review documents, and the exports behind the ads and analytics workstreams live. Read and write, no secrets.

plugins.name: Google Calendar
plugins.description: Optional. Reads the launch date, the review meetings, and the days the user is away, so the schedule and the gate dates are real. Read only.
